info.title: build_calculator_estimate
info.description: Drives the REAL Azure Pricing Calculator (via the ca-calc container) for one engagement and stores the calculator's own Excel export as the Proof of Estimate (POE) for Microsoft migration funding. Reads the engagement's published estimate (latest.json + tools_raw.json) and _engagement.json, translates the target-state design + right-sized workloads into a calculator line-item spec (Landfall supplies quantities, the calculator supplies every price), and writes landing_zone.xlsx / landing_zone.json / landing_zone.png to the engagement folder so the dashboard 'Azure landing zone — Pricing Calculator POE' card shows it. Call publish_estimate first.

post.summary: Build the Azure Pricing Calculator POE for an engagement
post.description: Pass the engagement id (<customer>/<project>). The tool builds a calculator line-item spec from the engagement's published estimate, drives the live Azure Pricing Calculator, captures its Excel export, reconciles the calculator total against Landfall's internal run-rate, and stores the result. Quote the monthly total, the reconciliation delta, and anything in 'skipped' (line items with no direct calculator module). The stored landing_zone.xlsx is the file to submit to Microsoft.

include_dr_compute.description: Add warm standby DR compute in the DR region (default false — DR runs on failover only; an ASR line is always included when a DR region is set).
